title: Cloudflare says it deployed default WAF mitigations for all free and paid tier customers to combat two PHP flaws, roughly nine hours ahead of public disclosure (Cloudflare)
summary: Cloudflare: Cloudflare says it deployed default WAF mitigations for all free and paid tier customers to combat two PHP flaws, roughly nine hours ahead of public disclosure — Today, Calif.io, Wiz, OpenAI and Quarkslab disclosed two vulnerabilities in PHP, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and known as php2shell.
